exact.分群無 $\\mathbf{y}$、自找模式；分類有 $\\mathbf{x}+: Clustering has no $\mathbf{y}$ and finds patterns on its own; classification is supervised with $\mathbf{x}+\mathbf{y}$. Same form of formula, different soul.
exact.同批點 $m=2$ 粗或 $m=5$ 細皆可；超參數 $m$ 是粒度旋鈕，無唯一: The same set of points works with a coarse $m=2$ or a fine $m=5$; the hyperparameter $m$ is a granularity knob, and there is no single correct answer.
exact.演示推開類間（紅低藍高）並收攏類內（揉成 (3,3) 與 (16,16)），幾何: The demo pushes the classes apart (red low, blue high) and pulls each class together (squeezed into (3,3) and (16,16)); the geometric score is the label.

efbf445fdd8f.zh: B. 分群無 $\mathbf{y}$ 須自找模式；分類有 $\mathbf{x}+\mathbf{y}$ 帶標籤 (clustering no $\mathbf{y}$; classification labeled)

58814104885a.en: C. The two are exactly the same

2a1591a3b227.zh: D. 分群只能分 2 類 (only 2)

dcd099972ff4.zh: C. 同批點可粗分 $m=2$ 也可細分 $m=5$，粒度 $m$ 由任務決定，無唯一正解 (same data, $m$ = granularity)
